label.en: By our authority (democratic / imperial / dictatorial / oligarchic)

texts.zh:
[preftl_different_flavors_planet.GetName]上的[preftl_different_flavors_species.GetNamePlural]震惊地发现，我们的政府组织形式与他们的政府不同。令人难以置信的是，纵观整个行星的历史，当地人从未经历过这种权力结构。显然，人们对于我们是否具备开展有效外交的能力产生了担忧。

他们不知道民主带给了我们什么样的好处，也不知道自由的真正味道。
texts.en:
The [preftl_different_flavors_species.GetNamePlural] on [preftl_different_flavors_planet.GetName] were shocked to learn that our government differs from their own. Incredibly, throughout the planet's history, its people have never experienced such a power structure. Obviously, this raises concerns regarding our ability to engage in effective diplomacy.

They know nothing of the benefits that democracy can bring, or the true taste of freedom.

label.zh: 将我们的三观传授给他们。

texts.zh:
在将我们的政治哲学传授给他们之后，[preftl_different_flavors_planet.GetName]上的[preftl_different_flavors_species.GetNamePlural]沿袭我们的方式，开始了政体改革。

这些计划正在全球范围内推广，迎来[preftl_different_flavors_species.GetNamePlural]的一个新时代。为了纪念这一政治意义上翻天覆地的巨大变革，新的[preftl_different_flavors_species.GetNamePlural]政府举行了一场向我们致敬的游行。
texts.en:
After instructing them in our political philosophy, the [preftl_different_flavors_species.GetNamePlural] on [preftl_different_flavors_planet.GetName] have taken steps towards reforming their government along the lines of our own.

These initiatives are taking place on a planetary scale, ringing in a new era for the [preftl_different_flavors_species.GetNamePlural]. To mark this dramatic political overhaul, the new [preftl_different_flavors_species.GetNamePlural] government held a parade in our honor.

tooltips.zh: 他们将会变得与我们相似。

texts.zh:
在学习了我们如何运用权力之后，[preftl_different_flavors_species.GetNamePlural]选择维持[preftl_different_flavors_planet.GetName]上的现状，认为这才是最好的进步方式。

他们已经宣誓要守住自己的本心，绝不因外部势力的影响而动摇。

外交仍然在继续进行，但毫无疑问，他们不像之前那么信任我们了。
texts.en:
Having learned of our approach to power, the [preftl_different_flavors_species.GetNamePlural] maintain that status quo on [preftl_different_flavors_planet.GetName] remains the best way forward.

They have vowed to stand their ground, and not be swayed by external forces.

Diplomacy continues, but there can be no doubt they trust us less.

texts.zh:
相较于向对方施加压力，我们更乐于冷静地向[preftl_different_flavors_planet.GetName]上的[preftl_different_flavors_species.GetNamePlural]解释我们的政体权力制度背后的相关理论。

他们深深地折服于我们就不同形式政府模式所阐述的观点，对于我们不曾尝试强迫他们服从这一点，他们表示了感激。

双方各自的外交官已经缔结了长期的联系纽带，一同庆祝一场共享的宴会。基于互惠的条款，外交持续推进。
texts.en:
Rather than applying any pressure outright, we calmly explained the theory behind our governing authority to the [preftl_different_flavors_species.GetNamePlural] on [preftl_different_flavors_planet.GetName].

They were intrigued by the insights we provided into alternative styles of government, and were vocal in their appreciation that we made no attempt to force them into compliance.

Our respective diplomats have formed lasting ties, celebrating together over a shared banquet. Diplomacy continues on good terms.

label.zh: 尊重是一条双向的超空间航道。
label.en: Respect is a two way hyperlane.

texts.zh:
[preftl_different_flavors_planet.GetName]上的[preftl_different_flavors_species.GetNamePlural]震惊地发现，我们的政府组织形式与他们的政府不同。令人难以置信的是，纵观整个行星的历史，当地人从未经历过这种权力结构。显然，人们对于我们是否具备开展有效外交的能力产生了担忧。

他们必须了解是什么让我们雄伟和强大的国度如此的雄伟强大。他们尚未品尝过帝国主义的滋味。
texts.en:
The [preftl_different_flavors_species.GetNamePlural] on [preftl_different_flavors_planet.GetName] were shocked to learn that our government differs from their own. Incredibly, throughout the planet's history, its people have never experienced such a power structure. Obviously, this raises concerns regarding our ability to engage in effective diplomacy.

They must learn what makes our great and powerful domain so great and powerful. They have yet to experience the taste of empire.

label.zh: 将我们的三观传授给他们。

texts.zh:
[preftl_different_flavors_planet.GetName]上的[preftl_different_flavors_species.GetNamePlural]震惊地发现，我们的政府组织形式与他们的政府不同。令人难以置信的是，纵观整个行星的历史，当地人从未经历过这种权力结构。显然，人们对于我们是否具备开展有效外交的能力产生了担忧。

我们应该将他们从这种愚行中解放出来。独裁政权的滋味将让他们重新放飞自我。
texts.en:
The [preftl_different_flavors_species.GetNamePlural] on [preftl_different_flavors_planet.GetName] were shocked to learn that our government differs from their own. Incredibly, throughout the planet's history, its people have never experienced such a power structure. Obviously, this raises concerns regarding our ability to engage in effective diplomacy.

We ought to liberate them from such folly. The taste of dictatorship shall set them free.

label.zh: 将我们的三观传授给他们。

texts.zh:
[preftl_different_flavors_planet.GetName]上的[preftl_different_flavors_species.GetNamePlural]震惊地发现，我们的政府组织形式与他们的政府不同。令人难以置信的是，纵观整个行星的历史，当地人从未经历过这种权力结构。显然，人们对于我们是否具备开展有效外交的能力产生了担忧。

将权力集中在精心挑选的一小部分人手中是统治的唯一方法。他们是如何意识不到这一点的，这真是一个谜。
texts.en:
The [preftl_different_flavors_species.GetNamePlural] on [preftl_different_flavors_planet.GetName] were shocked to learn that our government differs from their own. Incredibly, throughout the planet's history, its people have never experienced such a power structure. Obviously, this raises concerns regarding our ability to engage in effective diplomacy.

Concentrating powers among a select few is the only way to rule. How they have not come to realize this on their own is a true mystery.

label.zh: 将我们的三观传授给他们。

summary.text:
# 政府的特色 / Flavors of Government

- 分类 Category：文明纪事 Society (C7) · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-12
- 来源 Sources：`events/first_contact_dlc_events.txt:10144-10700`；`common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:468, 538-560`（on_five_year_random_pulse_pre_ftl）；`events/on_action_events_2.txt:3146-3179`（action.620/621）

## 如何开始 How it starts

- 每五年的国家检查运行 action.620：拥有“首次接触”DLC、且与某个前超光速文明有生效协议的普通帝国，会在 0–360 天后抽取“前超光速外交事件池”（无事 200，本事件 10，条件不满足的事件被跳过）。
  The five-year country pulse runs action.620: a regular empire with the First Contact DLC and an active agreement with a pre-FTL civilization draws from the pre-FTL diplomacy pool 0-360 days later (nothing 200, this event 10; events whose conditions fail are skipped).
- 条件：与某前超光速文明有社会启蒙协议；我们不是巨企也不是格式塔；每个帝国一次。
  Conditions: a societal enlightenment agreement with a pre-FTL; we are neither a megacorp nor a gestalt; once per empire.
- 发生后设置“近期前超光速外交事件”冷却，其他此类事件暂不出现。
  Afterwards a "recent pre-FTL diplomatic event" cooldown blocks the other events of this pool for a while.
- 8530 的 random_list 各项基础权重为 0，仅当我们的政体为民主/帝制/独裁/寡头且对方政体不同时为 1，因此实际按我们的政体确定显示 8531/8535/8540/8545 中的哪一个。
  8530's random_list has base weight 0 for every entry and 1 only when our authority is democratic / imperial / dictatorial / oligarchic and theirs differs, so our authority decides which of 8531/8535/8540/8545 is shown.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

- 「政府的特色」：他们惊讶地得知我们的政体与他们不同。
  "Flavors of Government": they are shocked that our government differs from theirs.
- “教他们我们的方式”→ 100 天后 80% 8550「渐行渐近」（他们会变得像我们）/ 20% 8555「外交分歧」；“尊重差异”→ 100 天后 8560「友谊长存，生生不息」。
  "Teach them our ways" → 100 days later 80% 8550 "More Like Us" (they become like us) / 20% 8555 "Diplomatic Differences"; "respect their differences" → 100 days later 8560 "Live Long And Let Live".

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 四个开场事件按政体互斥，选项与后续相同；8550/8555 为 80/20 随机结果。
  The four openings are exclusive by authority and share options and follow-ups; 8550/8555 are an 80/20 random result.
- 这是可重复抽取的随机外交插曲之一（各事件本身每个帝国通常一次），与同池其他事件没有固定顺序。
  One of the random diplomacy interludes of this pool (each usually once per empire), with no fixed order relative to the others.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 无额外的文明差异分支。
  No further empire-specific variants.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已核对：分派权重修正、四个开场、选项与延迟。
  Checked: dispatcher weight modifiers, the four openings, options and delays.
